translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for bruises, sprains, stiff shoulders, muscle pain, joint pain, muscle fatigue, low back pain, chilblains and pain from fractures.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. If your symptoms do not improve after about 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If a large amount is absorbed through the skin, symptoms of poisoning may occur, so avoid using it on a large area for a long period. This medicine is for external use only. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching; swelling. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
